criteria.text: Given I am on a protected branch, When I run git commit, Then the wall DENIES it and tells me to create a feature branch
Given I am on a feature branch, When I run git commit, Then the branch-protection guard does not fire
Given a repo first commit (no history) or a non-git dir, When I commit, Then the guard defers
Given a push whose destination is a protected branch, When it runs, Then the wall DENIES the direct push
Given a push to a non-protected branch, When it runs, Then the push guard does not fire
